candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Maintain heavy rain at the same intersection but nudge the oncoming vehicle closer to the ego’s lane approach, keeping ego mostly stationary while a near-side-pass collision impulse occurs near the end of the run with a recorded red-light violation.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Preserve the pattern of a red-light oracle violation with a late collision impulse near a close non-ego vehicle under heavy rain, while Autoware planning keeps publishing non-blocked waypoints and control commands remain essentially zero. Only the relative geometry of the non-ego vehicle is slightly tightened to reliably produce close proximity and a plausible contact without changing the uncertain fault-layer attribution.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure at least one signalized intersection along the original Town01 mission route still presents a red traffic light phase while ego is expected to enter or wait near the stop line.
Verify that actor_index 0’s path brings it within 2–4 meters of the ego’s expected position near the end of the run, without requiring ego motion to achieve proximity.
Confirm that Autoware is configured so vehicle_cmd topics (accel/brake/steer/target_speed) remain effectively zero over the run (e.g., magnitude < small epsilon).
Check that planning final_waypoints are generated and not flagged as blocked in the time window leading up to the planned collision impulse.
Validate that heavy rain conditions remain (rain > 80, wetness > 75) after applying weather deltas.
post_execution_validation_rules: Verify error.json contains at least one red-light violation entry for this run.
Check collision oracle topics (e.g., collision/impulse) report at least one impulse event near the end of the scenario, even if error.json does not log a crash.
Confirm that actor_index 0 comes within 0–3 meters of the ego at or just before the recorded collision impulse time.
Ensure final_waypoints remain present and not blocked for at least several seconds before the collision impulse timestamp.

Confirm vehicle_cmd remains near zero for accel, brake, steer, and target speed throughout the run, while vehicle_status or odometry shows at least slight motion of the ego during the collision window.
Do not infer lane_invasion as ground truth unless a separate lane-invasion oracle explicitly fires; log lane-invasion only as an observation if present.
uncertainty: Whether the collision geometry implies a lane invasion by the ego or by the non-ego vehicle remains unknown.
It is uncertain whether the ego actually crosses a red-light stop line versus being stationary within the intersection area when the red-light violation is triggered.
Module-level responsibility (perception vs planning vs actuation) for the combined red-light and collision behavior cannot be localized from these conditions.

note: Generated candidate scenario JSON for local DriveFuzz execution. It has not been executed in CARLA/Autoware.
